I have $889 and several properties. p1 is in jail with a strong orange monopoly. p2 owns a pink/magenta monopoly. p4 has a Mediterranean/Baltic monopoly with hotels and railroads.

I need enough cash to survive New York and Virginia. Dark blue properties will stay unbuilt until my cushion is safe.

p1 is bidding $114 with $320 cash and no yellow properties. They likely want to block me from completing the yellow set. I own Atlantic Avenue, p4 owns Ventnor, and p1 would need to buy Marvin Gardens to claim it. That leaves me with only one piece of the set.

A $115 win would net $25 profit and give me a mortgaged yellow property. p1 may push to $139 for a mortgage flip.

I am calculating rent threats from p1's orange monopoly. New York Avenue with three houses pays $650. Tennessee Avenue with two houses pays $200. St. James Place with two houses pays $200. These figures help determine if I can afford to hold the property.

Cash after a $115 bid would be $774, covering both New York and Virginia. Even at $170 the remaining $719 is tight but sufficient. p1 has only $320, so their maximum rational bid is $139 for a mortgage flip. They are in jail with developed oranges, so pushing higher would hurt them more than me.
